workout.name: Beginner Arm Workout
workout.description: A beginner-friendly arm routine to safely strengthen biceps, triceps, and shoulders using only bodyweight. Focuses on proper form and controlled movement.

exercises.name: Wall Push-ups
exercises.description: Stand facing a wall, hands shoulder-width apart. Slowly bend your elbows and bring your chest toward the wall, keeping your body straight. Push back to the starting position. Focus on controlled movement.
exercises.tips: Keep your body straight from head to heels. Avoid arching your back. Move slowly to feel the muscles working.

exercises.name: Knee Push-ups
exercises.description: Start in a plank position with knees on the floor. Lower your chest toward the floor by bending elbows. Push back up. Focus on engaging your chest and triceps.
exercises.tips: Keep your core tight and avoid letting your hips sag. Move in a slow, controlled manner.

exercises.name: Isometric Bicep Hold
exercises.description: Stand with elbows bent at 90 degrees, palms facing up. Squeeze your biceps and hold for 10 seconds. Relax and repeat.
exercises.tips: Keep elbows close to your body. Focus on contracting your biceps fully during the hold.

exercises.name: Tricep Dips on Floor
exercises.description: Sit on the floor, knees bent, feet flat. Place hands behind you with fingers pointing forward. Lift your hips slightly and bend elbows to lower your body toward the floor, then push back up.
exercises.tips: Keep your fingers pointing forward and elbows close to your body. Move slowly to feel the triceps working.

workout.name: Intermediate Arm Workout
workout.description: An intermediate arm routine for those who can handle more challenging bodyweight exercises. Focuses on building strength and endurance in biceps, triceps, and shoulders.

exercises.name: Regular Push-ups
exercises.description: Start in a plank position with hands shoulder-width apart. Lower your chest to the floor while keeping your body straight, then push back up. Engage chest, shoulders, and triceps throughout.
exercises.tips: Keep your core tight and spine neutral. Avoid letting your hips sag. Move in a slow, controlled manner.

exercises.name: Close-grip Push-ups
exercises.description: Place your hands closer than shoulder-width, under your chest. Lower your body while keeping elbows tucked close to your sides, then push back up.
exercises.tips: Keep elbows tight against your body to maximize tricep activation. Move slowly to avoid strain.

exercises.name: Diamond Knee Push-ups
exercises.description: Kneeling push-up with hands forming a diamond shape under your chest. Lower slowly and push back up, focusing on triceps.
exercises.tips: Keep your core engaged and wrists aligned. Avoid collapsing elbows outward.

exercises.name: Plank to Shoulder Tap
exercises.description: Start in a plank position. Lift one hand to tap the opposite shoulder while keeping your hips stable. Alternate sides.
exercises.tips: Keep hips as still as possible to activate core. Move slowly to maintain balance.

exercises.name: Reverse Plank Hold
exercises.description: Sit with legs extended and hands behind you, fingers pointing forward. Lift hips to form a straight line from head to heels. Hold the position.
exercises.tips: Squeeze glutes and press hands into the floor. Keep neck neutral and shoulders down.

workout.name: Advanced Arm Workout
workout.description: An advanced arm routine for those experienced with bodyweight training. Focuses on maximizing strength, endurance, and muscle definition using challenging movements.

exercises.name: Diamond Push-ups
exercises.description: Start in a plank position with hands forming a diamond shape under your chest. Lower your chest slowly toward your hands, keeping elbows tucked, then push back up explosively.
exercises.tips: Engage your core and glutes to maintain a straight line. Keep wrists aligned and elbows tight. Move slowly on the way down for maximum tension.

exercises.name: Archer Push-ups
exercises.description: Start in a wide push-up position. Shift your weight to one arm while the other arm extends straight to the side. Lower chest toward the weighted arm and push back up, alternating sides.
exercises.tips: Keep your body straight and avoid sagging hips. Perform controlled movements to avoid shoulder strain.

exercises.name: Pike Push-ups
exercises.description: Start in a downward dog position. Bend elbows to lower your head toward the floor, then push back up, targeting shoulders and triceps.
exercises.tips: Keep legs straight and core engaged. Move in a slow, controlled motion to maximize shoulder activation.

exercises.name: Plank to Push-up
exercises.description: Begin in a forearm plank. Press up one arm at a time to a full push-up position, then return to forearm plank. Alternate leading arms.
exercises.tips: Avoid rotating hips; keep your body straight. Engage your core for stability throughout.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Tricep Dips
exercises.description: Sit on the floor with knees bent and hands behind hips, fingers pointing forward. Lift hips slightly and bend elbows to lower your body toward the floor, then push back up.
exercises.tips: Keep elbows close to your body. Engage your core to avoid sagging hips. Move slowly to increase tension on triceps.

workout.name: Beginner Leg Workout
workout.description: A simple leg routine for beginners to build strength and endurance in the lower body using only bodyweight exercises.
workout.targetMuscle: Quads, Glutes, Hamstrings, Lower Back, Legs

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squats
exercises.description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart. Lower your hips back and down as if sitting on a chair, keeping knees aligned with toes. Push through heels to return to standing.
exercises.tips: Keep chest upright and core engaged. Don’t let knees collapse inward. Move in a controlled manner to avoid injury.

exercises.name: Glute Bridges
exercises.description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Lift hips toward the ceiling, squeezing glutes at the top, then lower back down.
exercises.tips: Avoid arching your lower back. Engage glutes and core at the top for maximum benefit.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raises
exercises.description: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart. Push through the balls of your feet to lift your heels, pause at the top, then slowly lower back down.
exercises.tips: Keep movements slow and controlled. Avoid bouncing. Engage core for balance.

workout.name: Intermediate Leg Workout
workout.description: A moderate leg routine designed to build strength, endurance, and mobility using bodyweight exercises. Suitable for those who have mastered basic squats and lunges.

exercises.name: Jump Squats
exercises.description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart. Lower into a squat, then explode upward into a jump. Land softly and go directly into the next squat.
exercises.tips: Land softly to protect knees. Keep chest up and core tight. Avoid collapsing hips inward during the jump.

exercises.name: Walking Lunges
exercises.description: Step forward with one leg and lower your body until both knees are at 90-degree angles. Push through the front heel to step forward with the other leg.
exercises.tips: Keep your torso upright and core engaged. Avoid letting the front knee go past the toes.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridges
exercises.description: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg extended. Lift your hips using the bent leg while keeping the extended leg straight. Lower and repeat.
exercises.tips: Keep hips level and controlled. Squeeze glutes at the top for maximum activation.

workout.name: Advanced Leg Workout
workout.description: A challenging leg routine for those with solid lower body strength. Focuses on explosive power, balance, and endurance using only bodyweight movements.

exercises.name: Pistol Squats
exercises.description: Stand on one leg with the other leg extended forward. Lower yourself slowly into a squat on the standing leg, keeping balance and control, then push back up.
exercises.tips: Use a chair or wall for balance if needed. Keep your chest up and core tight. Move slowly to avoid knee strain.

exercises.name: Jumping Lunges
exercises.description: Start in a lunge position. Jump explosively and switch legs in mid-air, landing softly into the next lunge.
exercises.tips: Keep your torso upright and land softly to protect knees. Use arms for momentum and balance.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squats
exercises.description: Place one foot behind you on a raised surface. Lower your body until the front knee is at 90 degrees, then push back up.
exercises.tips: Keep chest upright, core tight, and front knee aligned over toes. Go slow and controlled for maximum engagement.

workout.name: Beginner Abs Workout
workout.description: A simple core workout to help beginners strengthen the abdominal muscles and improve stability.

exercises.name: Crunches
exercises.description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat. Place hands behind your head and lift your shoulders off the floor using your abs, then slowly lower.
exercises.tips: Do not pull your neck. Focus on contracting your abs for every rep.

exercises.name: Reverse Crunches
exercises.description: Lie on your back with legs lifted at 90°. Curl your hips towards your chest, then slowly lower them back.
exercises.tips: Move slowly and avoid using momentum. Keep your lower back pressed against the floor.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.description: Hold a push-up position with your forearms on the floor, keeping a straight line from head to heels.
exercises.tips: Engage your abs and glutes. Avoid letting your hips sag or rise.

workout.name: Intermediate Abs Workout
workout.description: A slightly more challenging core routine to increase abdominal strength, endurance, and stability.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunches
exercises.description: Lie on your back with hands behind your head. Bring opposite elbow to knee in a cycling motion, alternating sides.
exercises.tips: Keep your lower back on the floor. Twist from your torso, not your neck.

exercises.name: Leg Raises
exercises.description: Lie flat on your back with legs straight. Lift legs up until perpendicular to the floor, then slowly lower them.
exercises.tips: Avoid arching your back. Engage your core the entire time.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.description: Lie on your side and lift your body on one forearm, keeping a straight line from head to feet. Hold the position.
exercises.tips: Keep hips lifted and body straight. Do not let your lower side sag.

workout.name: Advanced Abs Workout
workout.description: A challenging core routine designed to build strong, defined abs and improve overall core stability using advanced bodyweight exercises.
workout.targetMuscle: Abs, Lower Abs, Upper Abs, Hip Flexors

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Tucks (or Lying Knee Tucks if no equipment)
exercises.description: Hang from a bar or lie on the floor. Bring knees toward your chest in a controlled motion and slowly extend back.
exercises.tips: Keep movements slow and controlled. Avoid swinging your body.

exercises.name: V-Ups
exercises.description: Lie flat and simultaneously lift your upper body and legs to meet in a 'V' shape, reaching hands toward feet.
exercises.tips: Engage your core fully and avoid using momentum. Keep legs straight for full benefit.

exercises.name: Plank with Shoulder Tap
exercises.description: Hold a high plank position and tap your opposite shoulder with one hand, alternating sides while keeping your hips stable.
exercises.tips: Keep hips still; avoid rotating your body. Maintain a straight line from head to heels.

workout.name: Beginner Back Workout
workout.description: A gentle back-focused routine to build foundational strength and improve posture using only bodyweight exercises.

exercises.name: Superman Hold
exercises.description: Lie face down with arms extended forward. Lift your arms, chest, and legs off the floor, holding the position.
exercises.tips: Lift slowly and avoid jerking. Focus on squeezing the lower back and glutes.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
exercises.description: From a tabletop position, extend opposite arm and leg straight, then return. Alternate sides.
exercises.tips: Keep your spine neutral. Avoid dipping the hips.

exercises.name: Reverse Snow Angels
exercises.description: Lie face down, lift chest slightly off the ground, and sweep arms in a 'snow angel' motion backward.
exercises.tips: Keep chest lifted but avoid straining the neck. Move arms slowly and controlled.

workout.name: Intermediate Back Workout
workout.description: A bodyweight back routine to strengthen upper, mid, and lower back, improve posture, and increase core stability for intermediate fitness levels.
workout.targetMuscle: Back, Upper Back, Shoulders, Lower Back, Glutes

exercises.name: Supermans
exercises.description: Lie face down with arms extended in front of you. Lift your chest, arms, and legs simultaneously while squeezing your glutes and back muscles, then lower slowly.
exercises.tips: Keep your neck neutral, avoid jerking your body, and focus on controlled lifts to engage the back fully.

exercises.name: Reverse Snow Angels
exercises.description: Lie face down with arms by your sides. Lift arms and chest slightly off the ground and sweep your arms overhead and back down in a controlled snow angel motion.
exercises.tips: Avoid shrugging your shoulders and move slowly to maximize upper back activation.

exercises.name: Prone Y-T Raises
exercises.description: Lie face down, arms extended in a Y shape. Lift arms and chest slightly off the floor, hold briefly, then move arms into a T shape and lift again.
exercises.tips: Focus on slow, controlled movements and squeezing the shoulder blades together. Avoid arching your lower back excessively.

workout.name: Advanced Back Workout
workout.description: An advanced bodyweight back routine targeting upper, mid, and lower back muscles, improving strength, stability, and posture for experienced trainees.

exercises.name: Arch Hold with Arm Pulses
exercises.description: Lie face down and lift your chest, arms, and legs off the floor into a strong arch. Pulse your arms up and down while keeping the chest lifted.
exercises.tips: Keep movements controlled. Engage the glutes and lower back without overextending the spine.

exercises.name: Dive Bomber Push-Ups
exercises.description: Start in a downward dog position, swoop your chest toward the ground, and then press up into an upward dog position, flowing smoothly back and forth.
exercises.tips: Keep movements fluid and controlled. Engage the core to protect the lower back. Avoid locking elbows.

exercises.name: Plank to Dolphin
exercises.description: Start in a forearm plank. Push hips up toward the ceiling into a dolphin position, then return to plank.
exercises.tips: Focus on controlled breathing. Avoid sagging hips and maintain tight core engagement throughout.

workout.name: Beginner Chest Workout
workout.description: A beginner chest routine using bodyweight exercises to strengthen the chest, shoulders, and triceps while improving upper body stability and posture.

exercises.name: Knee Push-Ups
exercises.description: Start in a modified plank with knees on the floor. Lower your chest toward the ground while keeping elbows at a 45-degree angle, then push back up.
exercises.tips: Keep your core tight and avoid sagging hips. Lower slowly to feel the chest muscles working.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Ups (Hands on Table or Chair)
exercises.description: Place your hands on a stable elevated surface. Lower your chest toward the edge, then push back up.
exercises.tips: Keep your body in a straight line from head to knees. Avoid arching the back.

exercises.name: Chest Squeeze Push-Ups
exercises.description: Perform a standard push-up but focus on squeezing the chest muscles together at the top of the movement.
exercises.tips: Pause for 1-2 seconds at the top while squeezing your chest. Move slowly to maximize muscle activation.

workout.name: Intermediate Chest Workout
workout.description: A chest routine for intermediate level using bodyweight exercises to increase strength, stability, and muscle endurance in the chest and shoulders.

exercises.name: Standard Push-Ups
exercises.description: Start in a plank with hands shoulder-width apart. Lower your chest to the floor keeping elbows at ~45 degrees, then push back up.
exercises.tips: Keep a straight line from head to heels. Engage your core and squeeze chest at the top.

exercises.name: Decline Push-Ups (Feet Elevated)
exercises.description: Place your feet on a stable surface higher than your hands. Lower chest to the floor and push back up.
exercises.tips: Maintain a straight body line. Avoid sagging hips or flaring elbows out too much.

exercises.name: Wide Push-Ups
exercises.description: Start in a plank with hands wider than shoulder-width. Lower chest to the floor and push back up.
exercises.tips: Hands wider increases chest activation but keep core tight to prevent sagging.

workout.name: Advanced Chest Workout
workout.description: An advanced bodyweight chest routine designed to build maximum strength, stability, and hypertrophy. Focus on controlled movements and proper form.

exercises.name: Clap Push-Ups
exercises.description: Perform a push-up explosively so that your hands leave the ground and clap before landing back in push-up position.
exercises.tips: Engage core to maintain body alignment. Land softly to protect wrists and shoulders.

exercises.name: Archer Push-Ups
exercises.description: Start in a wide push-up position, bend one elbow while keeping the other arm straight. Alternate sides for each rep.
exercises.tips: Keep torso straight and avoid twisting. Control the movement to maximize chest engagement.

exercises.name: Pseudo Planche Push-Ups
exercises.description: Lean forward during a push-up with hands closer to your hips, placing more weight on the shoulders and upper chest.
exercises.tips: Keep elbows slightly tucked. Engage core to prevent sagging and maintain balance.

workout.name: Full Body Beginner
workout.description: A beginner full body bodyweight workout designed to target all major muscle groups with simple, safe movements. Focus on controlled form and steady breathing.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart. Push hips back and bend knees to lower down as if sitting in a chair. Keep weight on heels and chest upright. Push through heels to return to standing.
exercises.tips: Keep chest up, back straight, knees in line with toes. Go as low as comfortable without rounding your back.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up
exercises.description: Place hands on a stable elevated surface (like a bench). Lower chest toward the surface, keeping elbows at ~45 degrees. Push back up to starting position.
exercises.tips: Keep body straight from head to knees. Engage core and avoid sagging hips.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.description: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat. Push through heels to lift hips until knees, hips, and shoulders form a straight line. Lower slowly.
exercises.tips: Squeeze glutes at the top, keep knees in line with hips, avoid arching lower back.

workout.name: Full Body Intermediate
workout.description: An intermediate full body workout using bodyweight exercises to increase strength, stability, and endurance. Focus on controlled movements and proper technique.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.description: Start in plank position, lower chest to the floor keeping elbows at ~45 degrees, then push back up. Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
exercises.tips: Engage core, avoid sagging hips, and control the movement.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
exercises.description: Step forward with one leg, lowering hips until both knees are bent at ~90 degrees. Push through the front heel to step forward with the opposite leg.
exercises.tips: Keep torso upright, knees aligned with toes, and step far enough to feel the stretch in glutes.

exercises.name: Plank with Shoulder Tap
exercises.description: In a high plank position, lift one hand to tap the opposite shoulder while keeping hips stable. Alternate sides.
exercises.tips: Minimize hip rotation, engage abs, and maintain a straight line from head to heels.

workout.name: Full Body Advanced
workout.description: An advanced bodyweight full body workout aimed at building strength, endurance, and coordination. Focus on slow, controlled movements and full range of motion.

exercises.name: Plyometric Push-Ups
exercises.description: Lower into a push-up and explode off the ground, lifting hands into the air before landing softly back in push-up position. Engage core throughout.
exercises.tips: Land softly, control your descent, and keep elbows slightly tucked.

exercises.name: Jumping Lunges
exercises.description: Start in a lunge position, jump explosively, and switch legs in mid-air to land in a lunge on the opposite side. Keep torso upright and core engaged.
exercises.tips: Land softly, maintain balance, and avoid letting front knee go past toes.

exercises.name: Plank to Push-Up
exercises.description: Start in a forearm plank, push up one arm at a time to a high plank, then lower back to forearms. Alternate leading arms each set.
exercises.tips: Keep hips stable, avoid rotating, and engage abs throughout the movement.

workout.name: Full Body HIIT Beginner
workout.description: A beginner-friendly high-intensity interval training (HIIT) workout that targets the entire body, improves cardiovascular endurance, and burns calories efficiently. Focus on controlled movements and maintaining good form.

exercises.name: Squat to Knee Raise
exercises.description: Perform a bodyweight squat, then rise and lift one knee up toward your chest. Alternate legs each rep.
exercises.tips: Keep chest up, core tight, and land softly after each knee raise.

exercises.name: Modified Jumping Jacks
exercises.description: Step out to the side instead of jumping, swinging arms overhead and returning to starting position.
exercises.tips: Move at a steady pace, avoid locking elbows, and keep a soft bend in knees.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Ups on Wall or Table
exercises.description: Place hands on a wall or table and perform push-ups, keeping body straight and core engaged.
exercises.tips: Avoid sagging hips, keep elbows slightly tucked, and control the descent.

workout.name: Lower Body Strength Beginner
workout.description: A beginner-friendly lower body workout to build strength, stability, and mobility in the legs and glutes. Focus on controlled movements and proper alignment.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squats
exercises.description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, push hips back, bend knees, lower until thighs are parallel to the ground, then return to standing.
exercises.tips: Keep chest up, knees aligned with toes, and engage core to protect your lower back.

exercises.name: Glute Bridges
exercises.description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor. Lift hips toward the ceiling, squeeze glutes at the top, and lower slowly.
exercises.tips: Do not overarch your lower back. Focus on glute contraction and controlled movement.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunges
exercises.description: Step one foot back, lowering your back knee toward the floor while keeping the front knee above the ankle. Push through the front heel to return.
exercises.tips: Keep torso upright, engage core, and avoid letting the front knee go past toes.

workout.name: Lower Body Strength Intermediate
workout.description: An intermediate lower body routine to build strength, endurance, and balance in the legs and glutes. Focus on controlled movements, proper form, and engaging stabilizing muscles.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squats
exercises.description: Place your back foot on a raised surface, front foot flat. Lower your back knee toward the ground and push through the front heel to return.
exercises.tips: Keep chest upright, engage core, and avoid letting front knee go past toes.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridges
exercises.description: Lie on your back, extend one leg, lift hips toward ceiling using the other leg, squeeze glutes at the top, and lower slowly.
exercises.tips: Keep hips level, avoid twisting, and focus on glute activation.

exercises.name: Curtsy Lunges
exercises.description: Step one leg diagonally behind the other into a curtsy position, lower your back knee toward the floor, then return to standing.
exercises.tips: Keep torso upright, engage core, and maintain control to avoid knee strain.

workout.name: Shoulder Workout Beginner
workout.description: A beginner-friendly shoulder workout using only bodyweight exercises to build basic strength, stability, and mobility. Focus on controlled movements and proper form.

exercises.name: Wall Push-Ups
exercises.description: Stand facing a wall, place hands on the wall at shoulder height, lower your chest toward the wall, then push back.
exercises.tips: Keep body straight and core engaged. Move slowly to feel the shoulder muscles working.

exercises.name: Shoulder Taps
exercises.description: In a push-up position, tap your left shoulder with your right hand, then right shoulder with your left hand while keeping hips stable.
exercises.tips: Avoid rotating your hips. Keep core tight and control the movement.

exercises.name: Arm Raises Front and Side
exercises.description: Raise arms straight in front of you to shoulder height, then lower. Repeat to the sides. Alternate movements.
exercises.tips: Move slowly and maintain control. Avoid shrugging shoulders excessively.

workout.name: Shoulder Workout Intermediate
workout.description: An intermediate shoulder workout focusing on building strength, endurance, and mobility using bodyweight exercises. Ensure controlled movement and proper form for maximum shoulder engagement.

exercises.name: Pike Push-Ups
exercises.description: Start in a downward dog position, bend elbows to lower head toward the floor, then push back up.
exercises.tips: Keep legs and arms straight. Focus on shoulder engagement and avoid arching the back.

exercises.name: Plank to Downward Dog
exercises.description: Start in plank, push hips up and back into downward dog, then return to plank.
exercises.tips: Move smoothly, engage core, and avoid collapsing shoulders.

exercises.name: Y-T Raises on Floor
exercises.description: Lie face down, lift arms in a Y-shape, then in a T-shape, squeezing shoulder blades together.
exercises.tips: Keep neck neutral. Focus on controlled lifts and slow descent.

workout.name: Shoulder Workout Advanced
workout.description: An advanced shoulder routine to maximize strength, stability, and endurance. Focus on controlled explosive movements and proper form to prevent injury and fully engage the shoulder muscles.

exercises.name: Handstand Push-Ups Against Wall
exercises.description: Kick into a wall-supported handstand, bend elbows to lower your head, then push back up explosively.
exercises.tips: Keep core tight and body straight. Move slowly to avoid neck or wrist strain.

exercises.name: Elevated Pike Push-Ups
exercises.description: Place feet on a bench or elevated surface, perform pike push-ups to increase shoulder load.
exercises.tips: Keep head moving straight down between hands. Avoid collapsing the lower back.

exercises.name: Shoulder Tap Plank to Pike
exercises.description: Start in plank, tap each shoulder alternating hands, then push hips up into pike, return to plank.
exercises.tips: Engage core to prevent rotation. Move controlled and focus on shoulder stability.
